name: io.github.quizlar/mcp-server
title: Quizlar — voice-powered AI flashcards with spaced repetition
description: Create flashcard decks from YouTube videos, PDFs, web pages, or raw text. Run interactive text quizzes with automatic grading. Track memory with FSRS spaced repetition. Education-first MCP server: every tool maps to a feature real learners use daily.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Authorization header value. Mint a Quizlar API key at https://quizlar.app/settings/api-keys (format: sk-qz-<32 chars>) and provide as 'Bearer sk-qz-...'.
